items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Manzie Johnson was the drummer... We used to broadcast over CBS... we had -- Claude had left the band... Manzie Johnson and --

ctx.x: That's right. Manzie Johnson was the drummer and Talcott Reeves was the guitar player.
What a beautiful band. We used to broadcast over CBS three times a week and then every night we used to broadcast over [WMC.]
